description: Lists the countries a passport can enter visa-free, with a visa on arrival, or with an eTA (electronic travel authorization). The list does not say which of the three applies to each country. It covers only countries Wego has flights to and leaves some passport and destination pairs out on purpose, so a missing country does not mean a visa is required. This is a guide, not official visa advice: tell the user to check the entry rules with the destination's official sources before travel. Rows are sorted by popularity (flight demand), not by name. Each row has a keyCityCode for a flight search. An unknown passport code returns an empty list.

locale.description: Language of the country names: a language code such as 'en', 'ar' or 'fr', or 'zh-tw' / 'zh-cn'. A regional code such as 'ar-SA' gives English names. Default 'en'.

pageSize.description: Results per page, 1 to 200. Default 200, the whole list.

passportCountryCode.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 code of the country that issued the passport (e.g., 'PH', 'IN').
